findings.title: Stale day counts — SPRINT-B/Retell 83→89 days, Q3 elapsed 41→47 days
findings.detail: STATUS.md, KPI.md, ROADMAP.md, and INTEGRATIONS.md all carried day-count references from the 2026-08-11 audit. SPRINT-B overdue was 83 days (now 89), Retell R1 overdue was 83 days (now 89), Q3 elapsed was 41 days (now 47). Fixed by updating all four files.
findings.fix_sketch: Update all numeric day counts from 83→89 for SPRINT-B/Retell and from 41→47 for Q3 elapsed.

findings.title: SPRINT-2026-05-B not created — 89 days overdue
findings.detail: SPRINT-2026-05-B has been referenced since the 2026-05-21 reconciliation but remains uncreated as of 2026-08-17 (89 days overdue). There is no active sprint document. All milestone progress (M-002 through M-015) is blocked. Requires Sebastian + Esme to open the sprint file and define scope.
findings.fix_sketch: Create SPRINT-2026-05-B (or SPRINT-2026-06-A) with re-scoped milestones based on actual capacity. Requires human decision.

findings.title: Q3 2026 OKRs undefined — 47 days into Q3
findings.detail: Q3 started 2026-07-01 with zero OKRs defined. As of 2026-08-17 (47 days in) KPI.md Q3 section remains TBD. Prerequisites: Retell R1 confirmation (89 days overdue) + SPRINT-B scope decision. Requires Sebastian + Esme to define objectives and key results for the quarter.
findings.fix_sketch: Populate KPI.md Q3 2026 OKR section with concrete objectives and key results. Requires voice-platform decision and SPRINT-B scope first.

findings.title: SECURITY.md Protected Paths missing **/(auth)/** glob
findings.detail: CODEOWNERS and the protected-paths workflow use `**/(auth)/**` for Next.js route group matching but SECURITY.md Protected Paths section only lists `**/auth/**`. The gap means the SECURITY.md documentation understates actual protection. Fixing SECURITY.md requires operator approval (status: accepted file — ask-first per AGENTS.md §7).
findings.fix_sketch: Add `**/(auth)/**` alongside `**/auth/**` in SECURITY.md Protected Paths section. Requires ask-first approval per AGENTS.md §7.

findings.title: 3 ADR internal anchor links broken
findings.detail: Three ADR files contain anchor links to section headings that don't match (heading text changed after link was written). The pre-commit hook blocks edits to accepted-ADR files, so these cannot be fixed autonomously. Requires hook bypass or a new superseding ADR.
findings.fix_sketch: Either temporarily disable the accepted-ADR pre-commit guard for a targeted anchor-only fix, or open new ADRs that supersede the affected ones and correct anchors there.

findings.title: RISKS.md quarterly re-score overdue
findings.detail: RISKS.md specifies a quarterly FMEA re-score cadence. The last documented re-score was Q2 2026 (2026-06-30 deadline). Q3 started 2026-07-01 and 47 days have elapsed without a re-score. Some risk severity/probability scores may have changed given SPRINT-B not launching. Requires Sebastian to review each risk entry against current reality.
findings.fix_sketch: Re-score all FMEA entries (Severity × Probability × Detectability) against Q3 2026 reality. Update RISKS.md with new scores and rationale. Requires human judgment.
